scenes.title: Graduation
scenes.subtitle: Barre chords, rhythm and changes together.
lines: Today, we'll learn barre chords, rhythm, and how to change between them smoothly.
Let's try this strumming pattern: down, down-up, up, down-up.
It's a common rhythm that fits these chords well.

scenes.heading: You're a guitarist
lines: You can tune your guitar, play open and barre chords, strum in time, fingerpick and solo with the pentatonic scale.
Keep practising daily, learn songs you love, and play with others — the world is your stage.
Let the app listen as you try the chords and the solo — it's your time to shine.
